verdict.rationale: New Relic's APM agents add metadata to logs for "logs in context," and its log management connects logs with traces and other telemetry in one place. This is first-party trace-to-log correlation, but the docs never describe navigating from a specific trace span to its logs and metrics. Missing for 10: explicit span-level jump to correlated logs, documented span-to-metrics correlation, an end-to-end request debugging workflow, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can jump from a trace span to its correlated logs and metrics to debug a request end to end

citations.quote: add metadata to your logs, which gives you logs in context (ability to see logs data in various relevant places in our platform)

Our log management solution provides deeper visibility into application and infrastructure performance data (events, errors, traces, and more) to reduce mean time to resolution (MTTR) and quickly troubleshoot production incidents.
